summary: Provide an operator-facing node uninstall command with explicit data purge and private backups
details: usdb-node uninstall previews exact paths by default. Interactive --execute removes the selected network's software and stopped containers while retaining configuration and node data unless --purge-data is explicitly selected.

Data purge copies and SHA-256 verifies private configuration, monitor history, wallets, node identities and service definitions before deletion. Blocks and index databases require resynchronization; unrelated networks, old unreferenced datasets and Docker images remain untouched.

A standalone runner and durable operation record outside release/data roots support interrupted uninstall recovery. Active services, conflicting operations, changed targets, unreadable state, unverified backups and unsafe paths block execution.
The handbook documents preview, down/disable, software removal versus purge, private backup recovery, retained host components and reinstallation.
operator_actions: Install a node kit containing the new command and review usdb-node uninstall --help. Existing releases do not gain the command automatically.

Before explicit execution, stop the node, disable its controller and use a new backup directory outside the selected data/configuration/release roots. Retain the private backup and printed resume command.
